segments.text:
V. 74.
To ſerve him without fear—Without any ſlaviſh Fear. Here is the Subſtance of the Great Promiſe, That we ſhall be always holy, always happy: That being delivered from Satan and Sin, from every uneaſy and unholy Temper, we ſhall joyfully love and ſerve GOD, in every Thought, Word, and Work.
